test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the below mentioned items are NOT the part of revenue expenditure as per government budget?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Infrastructural Development Expenditure**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Infrastructural Development Expenditure** is classified as a part of **capital expenditure** in the government budget.
 
• Capital expenditure refers to spending that leads to the creation of **assets** or **reduction in liabilities** and contributes to long-term growth.
 
• Examples of capital expenditure include building **roads, bridges, dams, and other infrastructure projects**.
 
• Such expenditures are considered investments that improve the country’s economic capacity over time.
 
• In contrast, **revenue expenditure** consists of recurring expenses that do not create any physical or financial assets, such as **salaries, subsidies, and interest payments**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Salaries and Pensions**__

 __
 
• **Salaries and pensions** are examples of **revenue expenditure** because they are recurring costs incurred by the government for running its administration and welfare functions.
 
• These expenses do not result in the creation of any physical or financial assets.
 
• They are essential for maintaining the functioning of government institutions and providing support to retired employees.
 
 
 
• **Subsidies**__
 __
 
• **Subsidies** refer to financial support provided by the government to individuals, industries, or sectors to reduce their costs and make goods or services affordable.
 
• They are classified as **revenue expenditure** because they are recurring in nature and do not lead to asset creation.
 
• Examples include **food subsidies, fertilizer subsidies, and fuel subsidies**.
 
 
 
• **Interest Payments**__
 
 
• **Interest payments** are the cost the government incurs for servicing its debt obligations, including loans and bonds.
 
• They fall under the category of **revenue expenditure** because they are recurring and do not result in the creation of assets.
 
• This expenditure is critical for maintaining the government’s creditworthiness and financial stability.
